messages:
alex: Morning folks. My release notes now include: 'Fixed invisible bug that only appeared when the stars aligned and -O3 was jealous.' :joy:
maya: omg this is the best commit message idea i've heard today. also: YAML refuses to commit to spaces or tabs. it's complicated. :shipit:
jordan: compiler: 'i shall reduce thy code to elegant nothingness'
ci-bot: [CI] run triggered for branch feature/optimism - build (opt) succeeded 
sam: can we get a poll: which is more dramatic, a bug disappearing in optimized build or a YAML parser crying on prod?
alex: poll option A: bug evaporates with -O3.
maya: option B: YAML meltdown because someone used a tab under 'services'.
jordan: option C: the classic 'works on my machine' with extra incense.
sam: votes: A: 2, B: 3, C: 1 (hand-counted) :ballot_box_with_check:
maya: sticker idea: 'I survived undefined behavior and all I got was deterministic chaos'
alex: also 'Tabs: 1, YAML: 0' magnet.
ci-bot: [deploy-bot] note: canary rolled back to -O0 after ephemeral bug surfaced. :arrows_counterclockwise:
jordan: TL;DR: if your code only breaks when you add logs, it's a shy program. If it only breaks in -O3, it's probably been flirting with UB.
maya: coffee and a linter for everyone? :coffee:
sam: i'll bring the stickers. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
